English:
Kill 10 Zombies and find the Trader.

The trader is thru the double steel doors on the helicopter deck and down the hatch .

This starts your missions to complete the Destroyer of Dreams Challenge.
Kill 100 Zombies.\n\nGoal is to eliminate 500 Zombies and earn XP through multiple smaller stages the earn a M60 machine gun.
Kill 200 Zombies.\n\nGoal is to eliminate 500 Zombies and earn XP through multiple smaller stages the earn a M60 machine gun.
Kill 300 Zombies.\n\nGoal is to eliminate 500 Zombies and earn XP through multiple smaller stages the earn a M60 machine gun.

Kill 500 Zombies for a M60  Machine gun.
Kill 1000 Zombies.\n\nNow you're just showing off!

Wrench vehicles or check battery banks

Dont forget to gas it up.
You can find Trader Dawnrox in the makeshift sickbay at Jen's clinic. She is friendlier than Trader Rekt and deals mostly in Medical supplies.
Trader Hugh is a grizzled veteran holed up in his Army Surplus Store in the front of the ship. Hugh Got It. He's the guy to talk to for Weapons and Ammunitions from his personal reserve.
Track down Trader Shadow_Floodlight at his heavily fortified Hunter's Camp. Try and not bring any of those zed heads with you.
Talk to Trader Rekt at his place of business in the Rekt Feeds. He normally has a stockpile of Food and Farming supplies for sale.
Bob's Salvage is home to scrapped vehicles, broken appliances, and local gear-head Trader Bob. If you're in the market for Vehicles and Tools he's the man to talk to.
All seed crafting is unlocked by default, and some seeds only require a couple of food items to make. There are NO useable farm plots on the DOCKS or ships ...
All zombies will be loot able and have a chance to drop specific loot.
Skill magazines can be found in their usual places, and zombies also have a chance to give certain types of magazines
Loot is an integral part to completing this challenge. Loot will NOT restock.
Zombies can now be set to respawn after a time you decide. Check the 'Destroyer' tab on the main menu, and set the number of days (7) recommended, you want between zombies respawning on the ship.

Resources are scarce in the ship, but you will be able to find or craft everything you need to complete the challenge. Some resources, like old cash, can be used in recipes - so make sure you check the recipes for EVERYTHING. Also, some of the rarer resources, like acid, can now be crafted. It can also be looted from zombies - along with antibiotics and beakers.
Crafting workstations, and tools like the crucible, and vehicles themselves, take fewer magazines to read before they unlock.
Trying to leave the docks or ship other than by an UH-60 Apache helicopter  is not advised . The ground is SPICY and will end your challenge ...
If you are lost on where to travel to next, there may have been a kind soul who left directions in the quest instructions. Let's be real though, men neither ask for directions nor read instructions!
Thanks to w00kien00kie for the custom code, Khelldon for the custom menu, Frantic_Dan for UI Ideas.
Horde nights, better suck it up, buttercup.
There are many changes from vanilla for resource gathering. Clay soil, for example, can be found by harvesting potted plants, farm plots, and destroyed stone.

For a military vessel, there are considerable nooks, crannies, hidey holes and hidden stashes all over the place. Some say there are hidden shortcuts within the walls too! Navy brass would be rolling in their grave if they weren't ambling around in hordes of the reanimated dead...
Want to continue your mission you can craft a mission quest using Dukes.
Fear not, there is a water source, just keep a lookout for a dingy.
